description: Defines the AppTheme class for configuring the global ThemeData of a Flutter app, including light theme styling with specific design tokens and component themes.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate ThemeData configurations for the Flutter application, specifically a light theme.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData configured for light mode, with custom color scheme, component themes, and system UI overlay styles.

methods.name: _colorScheme
methods.description: Private method to generate a ColorScheme object with specific color tokens for the light theme.
